name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Added Party Groups and Party Categories with create, rename, delete, color badges, assignment, filtering, and search
Party group/category assignments are preserved across partial saves, cross-tab updates, PouchDB sync, and backup/restore
Deleting a party group or category now safely unassigns affected parties without deleting any party records
Fixed item category quick-add from both new-item and edit-item flows by removing the nested form and hardening Enter/Save behavior
Added full backup/restore round-trip and legacy backup compatibility for party groups and categories
Hardened the release workflow with a concurrency guard to prevent overlapping PWA/APK asset uploads
